tasks.name: חציון של שלושה
tasks.note: Median of three: needs max and min (or a sorting network) and elimination.

tasks.name: טווח של שלושה
tasks.note: Range of three numbers: max of three minus min of three.

tasks.name: האם ג בין א ל-ב
tasks.note: Inclusive betweenness test where the bounds a,b may come in either order (15=true, 0=false).

tasks.name: סכום משוקלל 1-2-3
tasks.note: Weighted sum a+2b+3c reduced mod 16, testing repeated addition with wraparound.

tasks.name: אם א גדול מ-ב אז ג אחרת ב
tasks.note: Conditional selection driven by a strict comparison of the first two inputs.

tasks.name: רוב אי-זוגיים
tasks.note: Majority vote over the parity bits of three numbers (15 if at least two are odd).

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-א מבין ב ו-ג
tasks.note: Two absolute differences, a comparison, then selection (ties go to b).

tasks.name: סכום או גלישה
tasks.note: Detect carry-out of a 4-bit addition and return c on overflow, else the sum.

tasks.name: מיקום הגדול
tasks.note: Argmax of three: return the position (0,1,2) of the largest value, earliest on ties.

tasks.name: ספירת ביטים
tasks.note: Popcount of a 4-bit number: extract each bit and add them.

tasks.name: קוד גריי
tasks.note: Gray code: XOR a number with itself shifted right by one.

tasks.name: היפוך ביטים
tasks.note: Reverse the order of the four bits, needing both left and right bit moves.
